name: Haloperidol
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.drug_or_class: QT-prolonging drugs (class IA and III antiarrhythmics, citalopram, erythromycin, levofloxacin, methadone)

key_interactions.effect: Low potassium, magnesium or calcium raise QT risk (label).

key_interactions.drug_or_class: CYP3A4 or CYP2D6 inhibitors (itraconazole, ketoconazole, ritonavir, paroxetine, sertraline, fluoxetine, venlafaxine, promethazine)
key_interactions.action: Monitor and reduce the haloperidol dose as needed.

key_interactions.effect: Haloperidol levels fall, by about 70% with rifampin (label).

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Opioids, anesthetics, alcohol and other CNS depressants
